subtitle: A real, zone-spread cluster for catalog-api, checkout-api, and cart-api

code:
az aks create \
  --resource-group rg-driftwood-prod \
  --name driftwood-prod-aks \
  --location eastus2 \
  --zones 1 2 3 \
  --node-count 3 \
  --enable-cluster-autoscaler \
  --min-count 3 --max-count 15
caption: --zones 1 2 3 spreads nodes across all three availability zones in East US 2.
A solid, production-shaped Deployment and autoscaler — against most checklists.
